Details: Minimum 80% attendance is required to be eligible to sit in the final examination.
Formal or semi-formal dress code is required; sportswear is not allowed in regular classes.
Students with CGPA below 1.7 are placed on academic probation.
Semester freeze is allowed once during the degree with Dean's approval and a valid reason.
Full fee refund if withdrawal happens before classes start; partial refund thereafter as per HEC policy.
Migration between FAST-NUCES campuses is allowed subject to seat availability and approval.
Credit transfer from another HEC recognized university is allowed subject to equivalence evaluation.
Students may repeat a course to improve their grade; the better of the two grades is counted in CGPA.
Unfair means in examinations result in disciplinary action ranging from F grade to expulsion.
